On Friday, Hungarian defense officials reported that fighter jets escorted airliners flying between Brussels, Sofia, Prague, Bucharest, and Cyprus, while NATO deployed air patrols near the Hungarian-Romanian border. Although no explosive devices were located and all affected aircraft landed safely, the disruptions caused widespread concern among regional authorities.

Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin described the threats as a worrying illustration of how easily normal societal operations can be disrupted to cause fear and anxiety. Spanish Foreign Minister José Manuel Albares characterized the continent-wide disturbances as a form of hybrid aggression and psychological warfare. Security experts note that the coordinated nature of the hoaxes bears the hallmarks of hybrid attacks, which officials frequently link to European support for Ukraine, though the Kremlin has strongly denied any involvement.

While investigations continue to determine the exact origin of the emails and whether copycat actors are involved, European nations remain on high alert. The disruptions highlight the vulnerability of critical infrastructure and transport networks to unconventional security tactics, prompting calls for increased vigilance and preparedness across the continent.

stories.title: European Stock Markets Drop Amid Global Sell-Off and Artificial Intelligence Concerns
stories.summary:
European stock markets commenced trading on Friday with widespread declines, as a broader international market sell-off intensified. This downturn concluded a difficult week for investors who faced growing uncertainties regarding artificial intelligence equities following the Democratic party gaining control of the United States Congress.

By 0810 GMT, the pan-European STOXX 600 index fell 1.6 percent to reach 644.72 points, while benchmarks across most major regional markets experienced drops exceeding one percent each. The losses suffered on Friday completely erased the index's weekly gains, leaving it down approximately 0.2 percent. Despite these decreases, the European index suffered less impact than Wall Street and Asian counterparts due to its lower proportion of artificial intelligence holdings.

Sector-wise, retail, healthcare, and media experienced the most severe losses, declining by over two percent apiece. Market participants worried that a Congress controlled by Democrats might pursue restrictions on spending related to artificial intelligence data centres, compounding existing anxieties over high valuations, debt-driven investments, and disappointing financial returns. Any reduction in such spending could negatively impact the global economy, which has heavily relied on investments from major technology firms.

Technology equities saw notable decreases, with Siltronic dropping two percent and ASMI falling 1.3 percent, whereas artificial intelligence equipment manufacturers such as Siemens Energy and Schneider Electric recorded marginal declines. In corporate earnings news, outsourcing company Teleperformance saw its shares plunge 18 percent. The firm lowered its full-year revenue growth projection after declines in its trust and safety division outweighed gains in its back-office and artificial intelligence-driven services.

stories.title: Pakistan Government Appoints Mustafa Ramday as Pakistan State Oil Chairman
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has reconstituted the Board of Management for Pakistan State Oil Company Limited, designating Mustafa Ramday as both independent director and chairman. The appointment carries an immediate effect for a duration of three years, according to an official announcement released on Friday.

Ramday possesses over 28 years of legal experience specializing in energy-sector, commercial, and constitutional law. Recognized as a Supreme Court Advocate and a former Advocate General of Punjab, he has provided legal counsel regarding clean energy projects, power generation, and the framework for the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor. Furthermore, he has represented various gas, oil, and power entities in international arbitration cases and holds a top-tier ranking for litigation and dispute resolution in Pakistan from Chambers and Partners.

Upon taking his new position, Ramday announced that he would perform his duties for Pakistan State Oil on an honorary basis without accepting any work-related expenses or directors' fees. He explicitly stated to the company and the public that he will forgo all costs related to travel, lodging, boarding, and directors' remuneration for any company-related work, regardless of whether it occurs inside or outside of Pakistan.

The newly formed board consists of several designated individuals alongside Ramday, including independent directors Muneeb-ul-Haq, Aftab Hussain, Imtiaz Hussain Kazi, and Saira Shahid Hussain. Ex-officio directors comprise the secretaries of the Petroleum Division, Power Division, and Finance Division, alongside the chief executive officer of Pakistan Limited.

Pakistan State Oil serves as the country's largest oil marketing company, maintaining the top market share in its sector. The enterprise manages the distribution and marketing of numerous petroleum products, including high-speed diesel, motor gasoline, furnace oil, jet fuel, kerosene, liquefied petroleum gas, compressed natural gas, petrochemicals, and lubricants. It also imports essential products to satisfy domestic needs and operates an extensive network consisting of 3,649 retail outlets, 19 depots, nine primary installations, and aviation facilities at 15 airports. The Pakistani government remains the largest shareholder in the organization with a 22.47 percent stake.

stories.title: US Democrats Expand House Majority to 253 Seats in Midterm Results
stories.summary:
Democrats strengthened their position in the United States House of Representatives, capturing 253 seats out of 435 as vote tabulation continued following Tuesday's midterm elections. According to media reports published on Friday, Republicans secured 157 seats, with 25 congressional contests remaining uncalled. In addition to their House gains, Democrats secured control of the Senate with a combined 54 seats held by party members and caucusing independents, compared to 44 for Republicans, leaving two Senate races undecided.

Several key congressional races shifted toward Democratic candidates through narrow margins. In New Jersey's 2nd District, Zack Mullock defeated Republican incumbent Jeff Van Drew with 50.8 percent of the vote. Cait Conley unseated Republican incumbent Mike Lawler in New York's 17th District, while Kristina Knickerbocker defeated incumbent Mike Turner in Ohio's 10th District. Additional Democratic victories included Richard N Ojeda II unseating Richard Hudson in North Carolina's 9th District, alongside flipped seats in Colorado and Arizona.

Meanwhile, Republicans successfully defended or captured several other legislative positions. Brent Taylor defeated Justin Pearson in Tennessee's 9th District, and Mike Kennedy secured Utah's 4th District. Other Republican winners included Amanda McKinney in Washington's 4th District and incumbent Anna Paulina Luna, who retained her seat in Florida's 13th District. In gubernatorial contests, Democrats maintained a 28-20 advantage over Republicans, while races in Alaska and Kansas remained too close to call.

The ongoing vote count and shifting margins reflect significant voter engagement and dynamic electoral outcomes across the country. The expanded Democratic majority in the House and control of the Senate establish a new political reality in Washington, shaping the legislative agenda for the upcoming congressional term.

stories.title: Rebel LIV Golf Tour to Liquidate After Failing to Secure Funding
stories.summary:
The breakaway LIV Golf circuit is terminating operations after a five-year run that disrupted professional golf. The organization announced Thursday that plans to revive the league under a new iteration known as "LIV 2.0" have been abandoned. This decision arrives after BC Partners Credit, the primary financial backer for the relaunch, withdrew from the arrangement. The investor pulled out after failing to secure firm commitments from several star athletes. Attorney Matthew Williams confirmed during a New Jersey bankruptcy court hearing that the circuit will commence liquidating its remaining assets on Monday.

Originally launched in 2022, the circuit was backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, which invested an estimated $5 billion before ending its financial support earlier this year. LIV formally initiated bankruptcy protection proceedings in September, initially intending to return next season with a condensed calendar, reduced prize funds, and player equity shares. BC Partners Credit had proposed an initial investment of up to $300 million. However, prominent competitors like Jon Rahm publicly exited the project in recent weeks, while other athletes remained undecided. Even Bryson DeChambeau, regarded as the circuit's top figure, did not publicly commit to a return.

BC Partners Credit released a statement expressing disappointment that mutual terms could not be established among stakeholders, despite strong backing for a revised circuit. Court paperwork indicates that LIV possesses between $500 million and $1 billion in projected liabilities affecting at least 1,000 creditors, which includes prominent competitors. Golfers Jon Rahm, Bryson DeChambeau, and Dustin Johnson maintain the largest unsecured claims against the tour, each exceeding $5 million in overdue payments. The organization stated it remains receptive to value-maximizing alternatives involving third parties throughout the winding-down process.

Chief Executive Scott O'Neil reflected on the league's accomplishments, noting that the enterprise delivered competitions across five continents, secured pathways to major tournaments, and attracted sponsors and diverse fans. The closure marks the end of a heavily financed circuit that fundamentally altered the traditional professional golf landscape by drawing top talent away from the PGA Tour. Management will now proceed with an orderly wind-down as the most responsible course of action given the current financial circumstances.

stories.title: سپریم کورٹ نے ملزم کی ضمانت منسوخی کے حوالے سے آٹھ اصول وضع کر دیئے
stories.summary:
سپریم کورٹ آف پاکستان نے ملزم کی ضمانت منسوخ کرنے کے سلسلے میں آٹھ اہم قانونی اصول طے کیے ہیں۔ یہ فیصلہ جسٹس محمد علی مظہر نے تحریر کیا ہے جس میں وضاحت کی گئی ہے کہ کن حالات کے اندر ملزم کو دی جانے والی ضمانت کی رعایت واپس لی جا سکتی ہے۔ عدالت کا یہ اقدام قانونی عمل میں شفافیت لانے اور عدالتی احکامات کے غلط استعمال کو روکنے کے لیے اٹھایا گیا ہے۔

فیصلے کے مطابق اگر ضمانت کا حکم ابتدائی طور پر غیر قانونی یا ناانصافی پر مبنی ثابت ہو، ملزم اس رعایت کا غلط استعمال کرے، یا استغاثہ کے گواہوں پر دباؤ ڈال کر شواہد کو متاثر کرنے کی کوشش کرے تو ضمانت منسوخ ہو سکتی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ دائرہ اختیار سے فرار ہونے کا خدشہ، تفتیشی عمل میں مداخلت، آزادی کا ناجائز فائدہ اٹھا کر اسی نوعیت کا دوسرا جرم کرنا، یا تفتیش کے دوران سامنے آنے والے نئے شواہد جو جرم میں ملوث ہونے کا اشارہ دیں، بھی ضمانت منسوخی کی وجوہات میں شامل ہیں۔

عدالتِ عظمیٰ نے یہ اصول طے کرتے ہوئے سندھ ہائیکورٹ کا فیصلہ برقرار رکھا اور اپیل خارج کر دی۔ لاڑکانہ کے تھانہ رحمت پور میں 3 مارچ 2024 کو درج ہونے والے ایک مقدمے کے پس منظر میں یہ کارروائی کی گئی، جہاں بجلی کی غیر قانونی فراہمی کے دوران تار ٹوٹنے سے نور حسین نامی شخص جاں بحق ہو گیا تھا۔ اس کیس میں سیشن جج لاڑکانہ نے ملزم علی اصغر کھوکھر کی ضمانت مسترد کر دی تھی، جبکہ سندھ ہائیکورٹ نے ایف آئی آر میں نو ماہ کی تاخیر کی بنیاد پر ضمانت منظور کی تھی۔

سپریم کورٹ نے اپنے فیصلے میں قرار دیا کہ ایف آئی آر میں تاخیر اور ملزم کا کردار ایسے امور ہیں جن پر مزید تحقیق کی ضرورت ہے۔ دریں اثنا، عدالت نے فیصلے کی نقل چیئرمین واپڈا کو ارسال کرنے کی ہدایت بھی کی ہے تاکہ بجلی کی چوری، غیر قانونی فراہمی اور پرائیویٹ سائفننگ میں ملوث افراد کے کردار کا جائزہ لیا جا سکے اور متعلقہ ادارے اس معاملے میں مؤثر اقدامات کر سکیں۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Approves Modernisation Plan for Trade Development Authority
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has endorsed a strategic plan aimed at modernising the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan to enhance national exports, improve foreign market access, and assist local enterprises, including small and medium-sized businesses. The endorsement occurred during a high-level assembly in Islamabad on Friday, convened to evaluate institutional reforms and assess the authority's overall performance.

During the session, participants reviewed the current operational structure, existing performance metrics, and challenges faced by the authority. A comparative evaluation involving international trade promotion entities underscored the necessity for integrated services to bolster exporter capabilities, develop domestic markets, facilitate global market entry, and drive export growth. The approved structural changes involve restricting the authority's focus to eight core responsibilities, redesigning its management and board, enhancing regional coverage, and integrating artificial intelligence alongside digital platforms.

Additionally, the blueprint incorporates measurable performance metrics and an independent third-party evaluation framework. A structured 12-month timeline encompassing design, approval, execution, and assessment was presented, with the prime minister instructing that the overhaul be finalized and operational by the middle of next year. Emphasising the significance of expanding global market reach, Sharif noted that a revitalized authority would accelerate export expansion and stressed the creation of a robust ecosystem for agricultural exports.

Sharif also mandated that qualified and skilled professionals be recruited through a transparent, merit-driven procedure, linking future career progression directly to performance and target attainment. Moreover, he instructed that an esteemed private audit firm be engaged to execute financial and performance evaluations of the agency. Highlighting the nation's favourable geographic positioning and substantial export capacity, the prime minister noted that the government continues to support local industries and small and medium-sized enterprises in leveraging these benefits.

The gathering included federal ministers Rana Tanveer Hussain, Jam Kamal Khan, Ahad Khan Cheema, Muhammad Aurangzeb, Attaullah Tarar, Shaza Fatima Khawaja, and Dr Musadik Malik, alongside senior officials, state minister Bilal Azhar Kiani, and adviser Haroon Akhtar.

stories.title: Bus and Dumper Collision on Hazara Motorway Leaves Eight Dead and Twenty Injured
stories.summary:
At least eight individuals lost their lives and twenty others sustained injuries following a collision between a passenger coach and a dumper truck on the Hazara Motorway near the Havelian Interchange in Abbottabad. The incident prompted local authorities to declare medical emergencies at principal healthcare facilities across the city, according to reports from Aaj News.

According to Rescue 1122, the passenger coach, operated by Faisal Movers and journeying from Gilgit to Rawalpindi, crashed after suffering a sudden tyre blowout. Initial rescue reports had indicated three fatalities and sixteen wounded passengers. Emergency responders deployed seven ambulances and a designated rescue vehicle to the scene, transferring the hurt individuals to local medical facilities for urgent care.

The initial death toll comprised two women and one man, all reportedly originating from Gilgit. Abbottabad Deputy Commissioner confirmed that the injured victims were admitted to Type-D Hospital Havelian, Ayub Teaching Hospital, and the District Headquarters Hospital. Furthermore, medical emergencies were proclaimed at the Ayub Medical Complex and Benazir Shaheed Hospital to guarantee prompt treatment for all affected persons.

Following instructions from the deputy commissioner, Additional Assistant Commissioner Havelian Muhammad Usama visited the crash location in the early morning hours and subsequently oversaw the medical arrangements at Ayub Teaching Hospital. Further information regarding the precise circumstances of the collision and the complete identities of the deceased individuals remained pending.

stories.title: KP Police Seek Rs25 Billion Extra for Security and Counterterrorism
stories.summary:
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police have submitted a formal proposal to the Prime Minister requesting an additional Rs25 billion for twelve districts during the 2026-27 fiscal year. This funding request is separate from the department's existing budget and is designed to boost operational capabilities, reinforce security infrastructure, and enhance counterterrorism operations throughout the province.

According to official documents, the financial breakdown includes Rs2.406 billion for weapons and ammunition, alongside Rs3.664 billion designated for transport, armouring, and armoured personnel carriers. The plans specifically outline Rs1.33 billion to acquire 140 four-wheel-drive single-cabin vehicles, Rs231 million for their side armouring, Rs903 million to bulletproof the sides of 43 existing vehicles, and Rs1.2 billion for 10 new armoured personnel carriers. Plant and machinery provisions total Rs2.304 billion, covering items such as seven anti-drone systems, 48 jammers, four VTOL drones, and 116 surveillance drones. Furthermore, the submission allocates Rs337 million for solar power systems across 226 police buildings, alongside Rs796.3 million for 3,792 bulletproof jackets and Rs208.5 million for an equal quantity of helmets.

Infrastructure development claims a notable share of the proposal, with Rs1.5939 billion earmarked for new police stations, a DPO office, and a Safe City building in Dera Ismail Khan, plus another Rs1.3 billion directed toward projects in Bannu, Lakki Marwat, Tank, and Dera Ismail Khan. The Counter Terrorism Department has separately requested Rs10.3 billion of the total funds to build its regional and district-level offices, procure specialized equipment, and acquire 82 surveillance vehicles.

This extensive financial blueprint outlines the province's added security requirements for the upcoming fiscal period. The realization of these acquisitions and construction initiatives remains contingent upon formal approval from the relevant government authorities.

stories.title: کنسر میں مبتلا بچے محمد فرقان کی پولیس افسر بننے کی خواہش پوری ہو گئی
stories.summary:
کنسر کے موذی مرض سے نبرد آزما کمسن بچے محمد فرقان کی پولیس افسر بننے کی دیرینہ خواہش عملی طور پر پوری کر دی گئی۔ کاویش اور فوجی فاؤنڈیشن کے باہمی اشتراک سے چلنے والے ادارے "میک اے وش" کے تحت یہ اقدام اٹھایا گیا۔ اس سلسلے میں آئی جی اسلام آباد محمد سہیل چوہدری کی خصوصی ہدایات پر عملدرآمد کیا گیا تاکہ اس بچے کے دل کی بات کو پورا کیا جا سکے اور اسے زندگی کی اس جنگ میں خوشی کا موقع فراہم کیا جا سکے۔

خواہش کی تکمیل کے دوران محمد فرقان کو ایک دن کے لیے اسلام آباد پولیس میں بطور ایس پی کا اعزازی رینک عطا کیا گیا۔ اس خصوصی منصب اور اعزاز کے حصول کے بعد ننھے فرقان نے تھانہ آئی نائن کا باقاعدہ دورہ کیا۔ اس دورے کا مقصد بچے کو پولیس کے روزمرہ کے پیشہ ورانہ امور، ذمہ داریوں اور کارکردگی کے طریقہ کار سے عملی طور پر روشناس کرانا تھا۔

تھانے کے دورے کے دوران پولیس افسران اور عملے نے ننھے مہمان کا بھرپور خیرمقدم کیا اور انہیں پولیس کے نظام اور فرائض کے بارے میں تفصیلی معلومات فراہم کیں۔ اس اقدام کا بنیادی مقصد سنگین بیماریوں کا شکار بچوں کی حوصلہ افزائی کرنا اور ان کے چہروں پر مسکراہٹ لانا ہے تاکہ وہ معاشرے کا فعال حصہ محسوس کریں۔

اس طرح کے فلاحی اقدامات معاشرتی سطح پر بیمار بچوں کی نفسیاتی بحالی کے لیے انتہائی اہمیت کے حامل ہیں۔ فوج فاؤنڈیشن اور کاویش کے اشتراک سے ہونے والی اس کارروائی نے نہ صرف محمد فرقان کی زندگی کے مشکل ترین دور میں ایک یادگار لمحہ پیدا کیا بلکہ یہ معاشرے میں محبت اور امید کا پیغام پھیلانے کا بھی ایک بہترین ذریعہ ثابت ہوا۔

stories.title: اسلام آباد ایئرپورٹ سے آف لوڈ کی جانے والی پاکستانی نژاد امریکی خاتون لاپتا
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد ہائی کورٹ نے اسلام آباد ایئرپورٹ سے آف لوڈ کی جانے والی اکسٹھ سالہ پاکستانی نژاد امریکی خاتون فرحانہ رفیق کے لاپتا ہونے کے معاملے پر سخت نوٹس لیتے ہوئے وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے (ایف آئی اے) اور پولیس سے تفصیلی رپورٹ طلب کر لی ہے۔ یہ حکم جسٹس شاہ رخ ارجمند نے لاپتا خاتون کی بازیابی کے لیے دائر کی گئی درخواست کی سماعت کے دوران جاری کیا۔ درخواست گزار بیرسٹر محمد علی عباس راجا نے عدالت کو واقعے کی تمام تفصیلات سے آگاہ کیا۔

درخواست کے مطابق خاتون اسلام آباد میں تنہا رہائش پذیر ہیں جبکہ ان کے شوہر اور دیگر اہل خانہ بیرون ملک مقیم ہیں۔ فرحانہ رفیق کو 5 نومبر 2026 کو ترک ایئرلائن کی پرواز ٹی کے 711 کے ذریعے استنبول کے راستے واشنگٹن ڈی سی روانہ ہونا تھا۔ وہ مقررہ تاریخ کو رات تقریباً تین بجے ایئرپورٹ پہنچیں جہاں امیگریشن کاؤنٹر پر حکام نے انہیں بغیر کسی وجہ یا تحریری حکم نامے کے بیرون ملک سفر کرنے سے روک دیا۔

متاثرہ خاتون کو نہ تو کسی سفری پابندی کے بارے میں بتایا گیا اور نہ ہی ان کے خلاف کسی زیر التوا مقدمے کی کوئی قانونی دستاویز پیش کی گئی۔ پرواز کے روانہ ہونے کے باوجود انہیں نہ تو ایئرپورٹ سے باہر جانے کی اجازت دی گئی اور نہ ہی گھر واپس جانے دیا گیا، جبکہ ان کا موبائل فون بھی صبح گیارہ بجے کے بعد سے بند ہے۔ درخواست گزار نے خدشہ ظاہر کیا ہے کہ خاتون کو کسی نامعلوم مقام پر منتقل کر کے غیر قانونی طور پر حراست میں رکھا گیا ہے کیونکہ ان کا کوئی اتا پتہ نہیں چل رہا۔

عدالت میں ایف آئی اے حکام کا مؤقف تھا کہ سفری پابندی کے باعث خاتون کو آف لوڈ کیا گیا تھا اور کارروائی کے بعد انہیں واپس بھیج دیا گیا تھا، تاہم وہ اس وقت کہاں ہیں اس کا کوئی علم نہیں ہے۔ عدالت نے اس بات کا سخت نوٹس لیتے ہوئے پولیس کو فوری طور پر معاملے کی انکوائری کرنے اور اپنی رپورٹ عدالت میں پیش کرنے کا حکم دیا ہے تاکہ حقیقت کا تعین کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: First Ever Sperm Whale Sighting Recorded Off The Coast Of Karachi
stories.summary:
The World Wide Fund for Nature has announced the first recorded observation of a sperm whale in the marine waters near Karachi. A board member of the organization, Zahid Maker, spotted the massive creature approximately 40 nautical miles southwest of the city during an expedition at sea. Video footage was captured during the encounter, clearly showing the unique physical characteristics of the animal, which measured 45 feet long.

Prior to this recent discovery, records showed that Pakistani waters were home to 26 different varieties of dolphins and whales, alongside various toothed whale species previously identified along the local coastline. Sperm whales are particularly noted for their exceptional diving capabilities, being able to descend to depths as great as 102 kilometers while hunting for nourishment.

Despite the rich marine biodiversity in the region, local aquatic species face persistent dangers. Major threats to these creatures include entanglement in commercial fishing nets, accidental strikes from passing ships, and ongoing pollution within the marine environment.

This landmark sighting highlights both the ecological significance of the local waters and the critical need for enhanced conservation efforts. Documenting new species helps environmental organizations better understand and protect marine life inhabiting the coastal zones of Pakistan.

stories.title: MQM-P Approaches Sindh High Court Over Local Government Act Amendments
stories.summary:
The Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan has chosen to challenge recent legislative modifications made to the Local Government Act 2013 by taking the matter directly to the court system. Expressing profound anxiety regarding the passage of these alterations, the political organization revealed plans to file a petition in the Sindh High Court very soon.

Action was initiated following specific instructions from party convener Dr. Khalid Maqbool Siddiqui, prompting internal legal experts to convene and formulate a strategic approach. Furthermore, a delegation representing the party's legal division met with former federal minister and Barrister Farogh Naseem to assist in drafting the constitutional challenge against the controversial decisions made by the Sindh administration.

At the center of the political dispute is a specific amendment that permits incumbent mayors and deputy mayors to transition into administrative roles once the official tenure of local bodies concludes. The opposing party sharply criticized this provision, characterizing it as a deliberate scheme designed to manipulate the upcoming local government elections unfairly.

Labeling the provincial government's actions as unconstitutional and driven by bad faith, the organization is insisting that administrative control be transferred to neutral, non-political figures after local terms expire. They argue this step is vital to guarantee that forthcoming electoral processes remain completely free, fair, and transparent.

stories.title: Pakistan Telecommunication Authority And Meta Block Thousands Of WhatsApp Accounts
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority, working alongside Meta, has successfully deactivated 176,000 WhatsApp accounts tied to recycled mobile phone numbers. This joint action forms part of an ongoing effort to combat cyber fraud and sets up a permanent framework to stop the misuse of inactive or cancelled lines.

According to regulatory representatives, these actions were initiated following numerous grievances indicating that recycled digits were being exploited to execute cyber crimes through the messaging application. To address this, the authority previously provided approximately 10 million recycled digits to Meta for thorough verification and subsequent account blocking.

To maintain long-term digital security, both entities finalized a permanent arrangement where 5,000 recycled digits will be transmitted to the platform on a monthly basis. This system allows for the systematic identification and deactivation of profiles linked to numbers that have been reassigned, ensuring phased prevention against potential exploitation.

Telecommunications providers currently maintain roughly 16 million recycled digits within their systems. When accounts remain active after original lines are cancelled, new subscribers inheriting those numbers can easily misuse them for fraudulent activities. This initiative builds on previous cooperative efforts where Meta successfully resolved 82 percent of grievances forwarded by the regulator over the prior year.

stories.title: Britney Spears Celebrates 25th Anniversary of 'Britney' Album with Unreleased Tracks
stories.summary:
American pop star Britney Spears' third studio album, titled "Britney," has received a special expanded re-release for its 25th anniversary. Distributed by Legacy Recordings and RCA Records, the updated collection features a total of 23 tracks, which includes the original songs from the 2001 release, additional recordings, and two remixes. Fans can now access five previously unheard tracks as part of the milestone collection.

The newly revealed recordings consist of "She'll Never Be Me," "Am I a Sinner," "When I Say So," "Right Now (Taste the Victory)," and "My Big Secret." Notably, "She'll Never Be Me" was co-written by Spears and Justin Timberlake and received an early official release in October. When the album originally debuted in November 2001, it marked a significant artistic transition toward a more mature sound for the singer, who was 19 years old at the time.

The original release included major international hit singles such as "I'm a Slave 4 U," "Overprotected," and "I'm Not a Girl, Not Yet a Woman." These additions offer listeners a deeper look into that specific era of her career. Now 44 years old, the singer has not issued a full-length album of entirely new material since her 2016 record "Glory."

Spears first achieved global stardom in 1998 with her debut single "Baby One More Time," establishing her status as a defining pop icon. Her subsequent run of successful records and hit tracks, including "Oops!... I Did It Again," "Toxic," and "Womaniser," firmly earned her the enduring title of the "Princess of Pop."

stories.title: South African Rand Declines Against Stronger Dollar Amid Election Vote Count
stories.summary:
The South African rand experienced a decline against a strengthening U.S. dollar as the vote tally for municipal elections continued across the nation. Early figures released by the electoral commission indicated a significant drop in public support for the governing African National Congress, introducing fresh uncertainty surrounding future local governance.

By early Friday morning at 0655 GMT, the local currency was valued at 16.5275 per U.S. dollar, marking a 0.3 percent decrease from its closing rate on the previous day. With approximately 72 percent of ballots officially counted, the ruling party captured roughly 32 percent of the aggregate vote, which represents a steep decline from the 46 percent it achieved during the municipal elections held in 2021.

Meanwhile, the primary opposition group, the pro-business Democratic Alliance, garnered around 24 percent of the counted ballots according to data released by election officials. Bureau for Economic Research chief economist Lisette IJssel de Schepper noted that the primary economic concern is whether these municipal outcomes will ultimately foster stable city administrations, improve municipal service delivery, and cultivate a better atmosphere for commercial enterprises.

Concurrently, the U.S. dollar appreciated by over 0.3 percent against a broader collection of international currencies. This upward movement was largely driven by safe-haven investor demand following a widespread selloff affecting artificial intelligence stocks globally. Additionally, South Africa's benchmark government bond maturing in 2035 showed slight weakness in early trading sessions, with its yield increasing by 4.5 basis points to reach 8.33 percent.

stories.title: راولاکوٹ میں سکیورٹی فورسز اور مظاہرین کے درمیان جھڑپوں سے کشیدگی
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے زیرِ انتظام کشمیر کے شہر راولاکوٹ میں قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں اور کالعدم قرار دی گئی جموں کشمیر جوائنٹ عوامی ایکشن کمیٹی کے کارکنوں کے درمیان فائرنگ کا تبادلہ ہوا ہے۔ ضلعی انتظامیہ کے مطابق بس ٹرمینل کے مقام پر مظاہرین کو ہٹانے کے لیے آپریشن کیا گیا، جہاں مظاہرین کی جانب سے فائرنگ کے بعد سیکورٹی فورسز نے جوابی کارروائی کی۔ انتظامیہ نے اس واقعے میں کسی ہلاکت کی تصدیق نہیں کی ہے اور دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ سکیورٹی اہلکار زخمی ہوئے ہیں۔

دوسری جانب عوامی ایکشن کمیٹی کی کور کمیٹی کے رکن عابد شاہین نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ سکیورٹی فورسز کی مبینہ فائرنگ کے نتیجے میں تین افراد ہلاک اور دو درجن کے قریب زخمی ہوئے ہیں جنہیں عارضی ہسپتال میں طبی امداد دی جا رہی ہے۔ انتظامیہ کا کہنا ہے کہ سوشل میڈیا پر اس واقعے کے حوالے سے بے بنیاد اور گمراہ کن پروپیگنڈا کیا جا رہا ہے تاکہ عوام میں خوف و ہراس پھیلایا جا سکے۔

کشیدہ حالات کے پیش نظر راولاکوٹ اور گردونواح میں انٹرنیٹ اور موبائل سروس معطل کر دی گئی ہے جبکہ آزاد پتن کے مقام پر راستہ بند ہونے کی وجہ سے راولپنڈی اور راولاکوٹ کے درمیان ٹریفک بھی معطل ہے۔ ضلعی انتظامیہ نے شہر میں دفعہ 144 نافذ کرتے ہوئے دو یا دو سے زیادہ افراد کے جمع ہونے پر پابندی عائد کر دی ہے اور شہریوں کو اپنے گھروں تک محدود رہنے کی ہدایت کی ہے۔

عوامی ایکشن کمیٹی کے کارکن اپنے مطالبات کے حق میں گزشتہ پانچ ماہ سے دھرنا دیے ہوئے ہیں۔ ادھر ڈسٹرکٹ مجسٹریٹ باغ نے ایک اعلامیے کے ذریعے شہریوں کو دس دن کے اندر تمام غیر قانونی اسلحہ حکومت کے پاس جمع کرانے اور لائسنس یافتہ اسلحہ معائنے کے لیے پیش کرنے کی ہدایت کی ہے تاکہ قانون پر عمل درآمد کو یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Martine Rose Takes Over as Balenciaga Creative Director Amid Kering Leadership Shake-Up
stories.summary:
French luxury group Kering has appointed British menswear designer Martine Rose as the new creative director of Balenciaga. Rose replaces Pierpaolo Piccioli, who served in the role for only 16 months. The leadership change marks the third creative shake-up within a month across Kering brands, as CEO Luca de Meo attempts to revive growth following a challenging three-year market slowdown that heavily impacted its major label, Gucci.

Rose, 45, launched her own eponymous label in London in 2007 and previously worked at Balenciaga for three years under Demna, the former creative director who now leads Gucci. Company leadership praised Rose for her connection to younger generations and her instinctive understanding of culture. Her aesthetic is heavily inspired by 1990s rave culture and street style, blending high and low fashion to attract a fresh demographic of shoppers. Her brand has previously collaborated with Nike and Supreme.

Piccioli, the 59-year-old former Valentino creative director known for colorful haute couture gowns, took Balenciaga in a new direction that drew mixed reviews from fashion critics. Having been appointed before de Meo initiated a comprehensive overhaul of Kering, Piccioli presented only three ready-to-wear collections and a single haute couture line during his brief tenure. In an Instagram post following the announcement, Piccioli expressed gratitude to his teams.

Kering continues to navigate a broader restructuring of its fashion houses. The group has not yet named a replacement for Anthony Vaccarello, who resigned in October after leading Saint Laurent for a decade as its second-biggest brand. Additionally, the Alexander McQueen label is currently without a creative director following the departure of Sean McGirr.

stories.title: پشاور کے علاقے حیات آباد میں فائرنگ سے نادرا کا اسسٹنٹ ڈائریکٹر جاں بحق
stories.summary:
پشاور کے علاقے حیات آباد میں پیش آنے والے ایک پرتشدد واقعے کے دوران نادرا کے اسسٹنٹ ڈائریکٹر فہد خان فائرنگ کے نتیجے میں جاں بحق ہو گئے۔ اس افسوسناک واقعے کے بعد پولیس اور دیگر متعلقہ اداروں نے جائے وقوعہ کا معائنہ کر کے شواہد اکٹھے کرنا شروع کر دیے ہیں۔

ابتدائی طور پر اس دلخراش واقعے کی مزید تفصیلات اور محرکات کے حوالے سے تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔ حکام کی جانب سے جائے وقوعہ کی تصاویر اور دیگر ثبوتوں کی مدد سے ملزمان کی تلاش اور واقعے کی تہہ تک پہنچنے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے۔

اس نوعیت کے پرتشدد واقعات نہ صرف سکیورٹی کے انتظامات پر سوالیہ نشان بنتے ہیں بلکہ محکمے کے باصلاحیت افسران کے اس طرح کے قتل سے ادارے اور لواحقین کو بھی گہرے صدمے سے دوچار کرتے ہیں۔ مقامی پولیس اس معاملے میں تمام ممکنہ زاویوں سے تفتیش کو آگے بڑھا رہی ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی کے علاقے دنبہ گوٹھ میں پانی کے ذخیرے میں ڈوب کر ماں اور دو بچیاں جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے دنبہ گوٹھ میں ایک افسوسناک حادثہ پیش آیا جہاں گھر میں جمع کیے گئے پانی کے ذخیرے میں ڈوبنے سے ایک خاتون اور ان کی دو کمسن بچیاں جاں بحق ہو گئیں۔ اس دلخراش واقعے نے علاقے میں سوگ کی فضا پیدا کر دی ہے اور مقامی رہائشیوں کو شدید غم و صدمے سے دوچار کر دیا ہے۔

ریسکیو حکام نے واقعے کی تصدیق کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ اطلاع ملنے پر امدادی کارروائیاں شروع کی گئیں۔ پانی کی گہرائی یا ذخیرہ کرنے کے انتظامات کی نوعیت کے بارے میں ابتدائی طور پر ریسکیو ذرائع نے تفصیلات فراہم کرتے ہوئے صرف اتنا بتایا کہ حادثہ دنبہ گوٹھ کے حدود میں واقع ایک پانی کے ذخیرے میں پیش آیا جہاں تینوں جان کی بازی ہار گئیں۔

اس طرح کے حادثات گھریلو سطح پر پانی کے ذخائر اور ٹینکس کو کھلا چھوڑنے یا حفاظتی انتظامات نہ ہونے کے خطرات کو واضح کرتے ہیں۔ ریسکیو اداروں کے مطابق پانی کے ذخیروں کے قریب بچوں کی موجودگی اور حفاظتی اقدامات کا فقدان اکثر اس قسم کے المناک نتايج کا سبب بنتا ہے۔

مقامی پولیس اور متعلقہ حکام نے اس حادثے کے بعد ضروری کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا ہے تاکہ واقعے کے حتمی حقائق کا تعین کیا جا سکے۔ ریسکیو ٹیموں نے جاں بحق ہونے والی ماں اور دونوں بچیوں کی لاشیں تحویل میں لے کر ضروری قانونی کارروائی کے لیے اسپتال منتقل کر دی ہیں۔

یہ سانحہ شہریوں کے لیے ایک چشم کشا ہے کہ وہ اپنے گھروں اور اردگرد پانی کے ذخیرہ کرنے کے مقامات کو مکمل طور پر ڈھانپ کر رکھیں اور محفوظ بنائیں تاکہ اس قسم کے دردناک حادثات سے بچا جا سکے اور قیمتی انسانی جانوں کا ضیاع روکا جا سکے۔

stories.title: فواد چوہدری کا حکومت کو مولانا فضل الرحمٰن سے متعلق پالیسی بدلنے کا مشورہ
stories.summary:
سابق وفاقی وزیر فواد چوہدری نے اپنے ایک بیان میں موجودہ حکومت کو مخاطب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ اسے جمیعت علمائے اسلام کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن سے متعلق اپنی مجموعی سیاسی پالیسی پر نظرثانی کرنے کی ضرورت ہے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ موجودہ ملکی سیاسی صورتحال میں اہم سیاسی شخصیات کے ساتھ حکمت عملی میں تبدیلی لانا وقت کی اہم ضرورت ہے۔

اپنے بیان کے دوران سابق وفاقی وزیر نے اس بات کا بھی ذکر کیا کہ پاکستان نے پچھلے چند برسوں کے دوران عالمی سطح پر ایک منفرد پوزیشن حاصل کی ہے۔ ان کے مطابق ملکی اور بین الاقوامی سطح پر بدلتے ہوئے حالات کے پیش نظر سیاسی فیصلوں اور باہمی تعلقات میں لچک اور تدبر کا مظاہرہ کرنا ناگزیر ہو چکا ہے۔

حکومت اور اپوزیشن کے درمیان تعلقات کے حوالے سے دیے جانے والے اس طرح کے بیانات ملکی سیاست میں خاص اہمیت کے حامل ہوتے ہیں۔ فواد چوہدری کا یہ مشورہ ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب ملک کے اندرونی سیاسی منظرنامے میں مختلف جماعتوں کے درمیان رابطوں اور سیاسی جوڑ توڑ کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔

سیاسی تجزیہ کاروں کے مطابق مولانا فضل الرحمٰن پاکستانی سیاست میں ایک کلیدی کردار کے حامل ہیں جو پارلیمنٹ کے اندر اور باہر حکومت کے لیے اہم ثابت ہو سکتے ہیں۔ حکومت کی طرف سے اس مشورے پر تاحال کوئی باضابطہ ردعمل یا جوابی بیان سامنے نہیں آیا ہے لیکن سیاسی حلقوں میں اس پر بحث شروع ہو چکی ہے۔

یہ بیان ملکی سیاسی جماعتوں کے مابین موجودہ کشیدگی اور اتحاد کے امکانات کے تناظر میں دیکھا جا رہا ہے۔ سابق وزیر کی جانب سے دی گئی یہ تجویز اس بات کو اجاگر کرتی ہے کہ موجودہ سیاسی چیلنجز سے نمٹنے کے لیے سیاسی مفاہمت اور لچکدار رویہ اختیار کرنا ضروری ہے۔

stories.title: شیخوپورہ میں آئل ٹینکر دھماکے کے نتیجے میں جھلسنے والے دو افراد دم توڑ گئے
stories.summary:
پنجاب کے شہر شیخوپورہ کے علاقے ماچھی کے میں ایک المناک حادثہ پیش آیا جہاں آئل ٹینکر پھٹنے کے نتیجے میں شدید زخمی ہونے والے دونوں افراد زخموں کی تاب نہ لاتے ہوئے جان کی بازی ہار گئے۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق یہ حادثہ تیل لے جانے والے ایک ٹینکر میں اچانک دھماکے کی وجہ سے رونما ہوا جس نے دیکھتے ہی دیکھتے خوفناک شکل اختیار کر لی۔

پولیس اور ریسکیو ذرائع کا بتانا ہے کہ دھماکے کی شدت اتنی زیادہ تھی کہ اس کی زد میں آنے والے افراد شدید طور پر جھلس گئے تھے۔ حادثے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی امدادی ٹیمیں اور پولیس فوری طور پر موقع پر پہنچ گئیں اور زخمیوں کو علاج کے لیے قریبی اسپتال منتقل کیا جہاں وہ جانبر نہ ہو سکے اور دم توڑ گئے۔

آئل ٹینکرز اور خطرناک کیمیکلز یا پیٹرولیم مصنوعات کی نقل و حرکت کے دوران حفاظتی اصولوں کی خلاف ورزی اکثر اس قسم کے تباہ کن حادثات کا سبب بنتی ہے۔ مقامی انتظامیہ نے واقعے کے فوری بعد علاقے کو گھیرے میں لے لیا اور ٹینکر دھماکے کی وجوہات جاننے کے لیے تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا۔

ابتدائی تحقیقات میں یہ معلوم کیا جا رہا ہے کہ دھماکہ کس وجہ سے ہوا اور آیا اس میں کسی قسم کی غفلت یا تکنیکی خرابی کارفرما تھی۔ حادثے کے نتیجے میں علاقے میں خوف و ہراس پھیل گیا جبکہ جاں بحق ہونے والے افراد کے لواحقین میں گہرے صدمے کی لہر دوڑ گئی ہے۔

مقامی پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ حادثے کے حوالے سے تمام قانونی تقاضے پورے کیے جا رہے ہیں اور لاشوں کو ضروری کارروائی کے بعد ورثاء کے حوالے کر دیا جائے گا۔ اس طرح کے دردناک واقعات اس بات کا تقاضا کرتے ہیں کہ سڑکوں پر خطرناک مواد لے جانے والی گاڑیوں کی فٹنس اور حفاظتی تدبیروں کا سخت سے سخت جائزہ لیا جائے۔

stories.title: Paraguayan President Santiago Pena Faces Impeachment Amid Banking Crisis
stories.summary:
Paraguayan President Santiago Pena is facing an imminent impeachment trial following a severe financial crisis that erupted after the Central Bank seized Ueno Bank, freezing the deposits of approximately three million citizens. The sudden takeover blocked countless citizens from accessing their funds, triggering widespread protests, clashes with police using tear gas and water cannons, and loud public demands for the president's removal.

In response to the mounting pressure, Pena announced his resignation in a video message posted on social media, apologizing to the public and stating that his priority remained the stability of the financial system. However, Congress voted unanimously to reject his immediate resignation and instead move forward with impeachment proceedings, accusing the right-wing leader of misconduct and conflicts of interest tied to the bank. Interior Minister Enrique Riera also resigned from his post amid the chaos and was replaced on an interim basis by Carlos Benitez.

Protesters and opposition figures strongly criticized the administration over the crisis, citing severe hardships caused by blocked savings and undelivered housing loans. Although Pena previously sold his shares in the holding group controlling Ueno Bank last year and attempted to appease the public by dismissing Central Bank president Carlos Carvallo, these measures failed to quell public anger.

Lawmakers scheduled the impeachment trial to begin on Friday morning. If convicted, Vice President Pedro Alliana is prepared to assume leadership of the South American nation as authorities attempt to restore public trust and stabilize the disrupted banking sector.

stories.title: India Moves International Cricket Match from Delhi Due to Extreme Smog
stories.summary:
India's cricket board has officially relocated an upcoming international cricket fixture out of New Delhi due to worsening air pollution and potential weather disruptions. The one-day international match between India and Sri Lanka, originally planned for December, will instead take place in the southeastern coastal city of Visakhapatnam on December 13.

The relocation comes as toxic smog blankets the Indian capital, with air monitoring data showing pollution levels surging past 25 times the recommended daily limit set by the World Health Organization. During the winter season, colder weather patterns trap harmful pollutants near the ground, frequently driving PM2.5 concentrations above 800 micrograms per cubic metre.

Air pollution remains a severe health hazard in the megacity, having been linked to an estimated 17,188 fatalities in Delhi during 2023 alone, accounting for nearly 15 percent of total deaths. Authorities anticipate that environmental conditions will deteriorate further with upcoming Diwali celebrations, as traditional fireworks displays contribute additional particulate matter to the already toxic atmosphere.

stories.title: Turkish Parliament Ratifies Makkah Joint Defence Pact with Pakistan and Saudi Arabia
stories.summary:
The Turkish parliament has approved a bill ratifying the Makkah Agreement on Joint Defence alongside Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, formally advancing the trilateral security pact toward implementation. Lawmakers endorsed the agreement by a vote of 279 to 119 during a session where 398 members participated out of the 592-seat chamber.

During parliamentary debates, ruling Justice and Development Party lawmaker Ziya Altunyaldiz emphasized that the treaty aims to broaden regional security collaboration without targeting any third party, focusing primarily on conflict prevention rather than escalation. Meanwhile, opposition representatives raised concerns regarding the pact's precise scope and the necessity of ensuring it does not conflict with Turkey's other international obligations.

The three nations originally signed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement during an August 7 summit in Makkah, establishing a framework for mutual assistance in the event of external armed aggression. Implementation steps gained momentum following an October meeting in Riyadh by the alliance's Strategic, Political and Defence Committee, which called for rapid deployment of agreed military capabilities in accordance with national laws.

stories.title: Documentary 'One in a Million' Chronicles a Syrian Refugee's Decade-Long Journey
stories.summary:
The documentary film "One in a Million" follows the decade-long journey of Israa, a Syrian refugee who fled the war-torn city of Aleppo with her family. Filmmakers Jack MacInnes and Itab Azzam first crossed paths with Israa in 2015 when she was 11 years old and selling cigarettes with her father on a street corner in Turkiye. Charmed by her bubbly personality, the filmmakers decided to document her family's perilous trek across eight countries as they sought safety and a new life in Germany.

The filmmakers embedded themselves deeply into the family's daily existence, sharing harsh conditions such as sleeping on the streets in the rain and enduring freezing weather in Serbia and Croatia. By the time they reached Germany, the crew and the family had bonded closely, forming a dynamic akin to relatives. The resulting coming-of-age movie captures Israa's transition into adulthood, detailing her experiences crossing borders, adapting to German society, and navigating the friction between newfound freedoms and traditional family expectations.

Viewers follow Israa through adolescence, marriage, and early motherhood as she strives to discover her identity amid shifting circumstances at home. In a poignant turn of events, a married Israa eventually returns to visit her homeland alongside her husband following the 2024 overthrow of Bashar al-Assad. The directors hope the project humanizes the refugee experience, countering political rhetoric by allowing audiences to understand the profound complexities of displacement.

The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in January, where it claimed the Audience Award to immense emotional reception, featuring a surprise appearance by Israa herself. "One in a Million" officially opens in United Kingdom cinemas on Friday, bringing the spotlight back to a young girl who once faced hostility and neglect on a foreign street corner.

stories.title: NADRA Official Shot Dead by Unknown Assailants in Peshawar
stories.summary:
An assistant director working for the National Database and Registration Authority, identified as Fahad, was fatally shot by unidentified attackers in Peshawar. Local law enforcement reported that the violent incident occurred near the NADRA office situated in Hayatabad Phase 5.

Investigators at the crime scene collected eight empty bullet shells from a .30-bore pistol following the shooting. Authorities transferred the victim's body to a hospital to undergo a post-mortem examination while officially launching an active investigation into the killing.

This occurrence follows another recent violent event involving the organization, where a husband named Bilal allegedly shot and killed his wife Amber at a Gujrat NADRA office following a workplace argument before committing suicide. Both individuals were employed at that branch.

The string of violent incidents draws significant public and official attention to safety concerns surrounding agency employees. Police continue to probe the circumstances behind the Peshawar shooting to identify and apprehend the culprits responsible for the murder.

stories.title: Pakistani MMA Fighter Maliha Ali Claims Bronze Amid Semi-Final Dispute
stories.summary:
Maliha Ali secured a bronze medal at the IMMAF World Championships in Tbilisi, Georgia, following a controversial split-decision defeat in the featherweight semi-finals. Competing in the 65.8kg division, Maliha pushed through injuries including a fractured toe, a bruised eyelid, and a partially dislocated jaw. En route to the semi-finals, she defeated Russia's Veronika Drozdova and Mexico's Andrea Gabriela Guzman Salazar.

Her tournament run ended against 23-year-old Russian Polina Baldina, a former world champion from another MMA federation. The judges returned three disparate scorecards: 30-27 for Baldina, 29-28 for Maliha, and 29-28 for Baldina, handing the win to the Russian fighter. Following the bout, the Pakistan MMA Federation filed a formal appeal with the Head of the IMMAF Refereeing and Judging Commission, requesting a technical review and a round-by-round scoring breakdown.

Omar Ahmed, president of the Pakistan MMA Federation, criticized the outcome and raised concerns regarding officiating standards. He alleged that ex-Soviet states frequently favor each other in judging panels, noting that Pakistan also lost a semi-final by split decision at the previous year's championships. The federation contrasted Russia's substantial budget and multiple fighters per weight class with Pakistan's lack of representation on the officiating panel.

The tournament brought mixed results for the family, as Maliha's twin sister, Manesha Ali, suffered a narrow split-decision loss in the lightweight quarter-finals to Poland's Martyna Caruk. Manesha had previously won gold at the IMMAF World Cup in Angola earlier in the year. The official appeal regarding Maliha's semi-final match remains pending as the federation presses for a comprehensive review.

stories.title: Thailand October Headline Consumer Prices Increase 3.90 Percent Year-On-Year
stories.summary:
Thailand's headline consumer price index increased by 3.90 percent in October compared to the same month in the previous year, according to data released by the commerce ministry on Friday. This figure demonstrates an acceleration in price growth following a 2.82 percent annual increase recorded during the prior month.

The October inflation rate outpaced market expectations significantly. A Reuters poll of forecasters had anticipated a more modest increase of 3.24 percent for the month. Furthermore, the actual reading surpassed the central bank's established inflation target range, which spans from 1 percent to 3 percent.

Alongside the headline figure, the ministry reported data for core inflation. The core consumer price index, a metric that strips out volatile fresh food and energy costs, rose by 1.58 percent in October compared to the corresponding period of the previous year.

The higher-than-expected figures highlight ongoing price pressures within the Thai economy. These sustained increases above the central bank's target threshold provide key context for future monetary policy considerations in the country.

stories.title: Australian Cricketer Chris Lynn Serves One-Month Ban for Cocaine Use
stories.summary:
Australian batter Chris Lynn completed a one-month ban after testing positive for a cocaine metabolite during England's domestic Twenty20 competition. The 36-year-old cricketer returned the positive sample on July 18 while representing Northamptonshire on T20 Blast Finals Day, an event won by his team.

Following a provisional suspension initiated on July 31, Lynn admitted to using cocaine between July 15 and 16. The English cricket regulator accepted that the substance was consumed out of competition and bore no relation to his sporting performance. Additionally, one of the two initial anti-doping charges was dropped because the detected level in his sample fell below the threshold mandated by World Anti-Doping Agency rules.

The regulatory body initially pursued a three-month suspension for the player. However, the penalty was reduced to one month after Lynn agreed to participate in and complete a substance abuse treatment program, which he finished on August 30.

Lynn has represented Australia in four one-day internationals and 18 T20 matches. He has not played professional cricket since his suspension began and has not yet secured a contract with a Big Bash League team for the upcoming season.

stories.title: London Police Chief Expects Additional Complaints Against Convicted Russell Brand
stories.summary:
The head of London's Metropolitan Police announced on Friday that numerous additional women might step forward with allegations against Russell Brand, following the disgraced comedian's recent legal conviction. Brand, aged 51, was found guilty of one count of rape and three charges of sexual assault involving four women after a high-profile trial. He was acquitted of two alternative rape counts and a charge of attempted indecent assault regarding two other individuals. Remanded into custody, the judge informed him that he faces a substantial prison sentence during his upcoming sentencing hearing on Monday.

The prominent entertainer, who gained widespread fame across the United Kingdom during the 2000s, is currently under investigation by the Metropolitan Police for additional allegations involving two more women, which includes a 16-year-old schoolgirl. Metropolitan Police chief Mark Rowley stated to the BBC that authorities are actively investigating two extra cases and noted he would not be surprised if many more complainants emerged. Following the verdicts, Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy commended the exceptional bravery and resilience of the victims, stating that Brand leveraged his status, fame, and influence to exploit and sexually assault women.

The verdicts have placed intense scrutiny on major media institutions where Brand previously worked, including the BBC, Channel 4, and MTV. Critics and advocacy groups, such as domestic abuse charity Women's Aid led by Farah Nazeer, argued that powerful men must face accountability and that broadcasters need to confront the systemic environments that previously enabled Brand's actions. The BBC issued a fresh apology regarding past institutional failures during Brand's tenure with the broadcaster from 2006 to 2008, before he departed amid controversy surrounding explicit messages sent to a well-known actor.

Throughout his career, Brand cultivated a public persona centered on lewd humor and promiscuity, even achieving global prominence following a brief marriage to American pop star Katy Perry in 2010. Despite past controversies, he maintained a presence on mainstream television before more recently reinventing himself as an online Christian commentator and digital guru. As the legal proceedings conclude, industry leaders emphasize the necessity of fostering environments where victims feel safe to report misconduct.

stories.title: New Zealand Rules Out Devon Conway for Remainder of India ODI Series
stories.summary:
New Zealand opener Devon Conway will miss the remainder of the one-day international series against India due to a concussion. The injury occurred earlier in the week during a training collision with teammate Matt Henry.

Fast bowler Henry was cleared of concussion following medical checks after the same training incident and remains available for selection. He is set to play in the second ODI, which takes place in Wellington on Saturday. Meanwhile, New Zealand called up left-handed top-order batter Nick Kelly early from the New Zealand 'A' squad to fill Conway's spot.

India currently leads the five-match series 1-0 after winning the rain-disrupted opening ODI by five wickets in Auckland on Wednesday. The loss of Conway is a significant blow to the New Zealand batting lineup.

New Zealand management is monitoring Conway's recovery closely. The team hopes the batting mainstay will recover fully ahead of the first of two test matches against India, which is scheduled to begin in Wellington on November 19.

stories.title: اسعد محمود اور قریبی ساتھیوں کی طلبی، حکومت اور مولانا فضل الرحمان میں تناؤ
stories.summary:
جمعیت علمائے اسلام (ف) کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمان اور وفاقی حکومت کے درمیان سیاسی کشیدگی اب قانونی اور ادارہ جاتی تحقیقات تک پہنچ گئی ہے۔ قومی احتساب بیورو، وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے اور کیپیٹل ڈیولپمنٹ اتھارٹی نے مولانا کے صاحبزادے اسعد محمود اور ان کے بعض قریبی ساتھیوں کو نوٹس جاری کیے ہیں۔ یہ پیش رفت ایسے وقت میں ہوئی ہے جب مولانا فضل الرحمان خیبر پختونخوا میں گورنر راج اور وفاقی حکومت کی پالیسیوں پر کھل کر تنقید کر رہے ہیں۔

نیب راولپنڈی نے سابق وفاقی وزیر مواصلات اسعد محمود کو پاکستان پوسٹ آفس میں مبینہ غیر قانونی بھرتیوں کے معاملے پر 10 نومبر کو طلب کیا ہے۔ نیب کے مطابق اسٹیبلشمنٹ ڈویژن کی اجازت سے زیادہ بھرتیاں کی گئیں اور ختم شدہ اسامیوں پر بھی تقرریاں کی گئیں جس سے قومی خزانے پر بوجھ پڑا۔ اس کے علاوہ ایف آئی اے کے اینٹی کرپشن سرکل نے بھی اسی بھرتی کیس میں اسعد محمود کو نوٹس جاری کیا ہے۔

ادھر سی ڈی اے نے اس مکان کے مالک کو نوٹس جاری کیا ہے جہاں مولانا فضل الرحمان رہائش پزیر ہیں، جس میں عمارت میں غیر قانونی تعمیرات اور جنریٹر کی تنصیب پر اعتراض اٹھایا گیا ہے اور پندرہ دن میں خلاف ورزیاں ختم کرنے کی ہدایت کی گئی ہے۔ جے یو آئی رہنماؤں نے ان کارروائیوں کو سیاسی انتقام قرار دیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ ان کی جماعت حکومتی ہتھکنڈوں سے خائف نہیں ہو گی۔

حکومت کی جانب سے مؤقف اختیار کیا گیا ہے کہ یہ کارروائیاں سیاسی بنیادوں پر نہیں بلکہ قانون کی بالادستی کے لیے کی جا رہی ہیں۔ ملک میں سیاسی تناؤ کا یہ پس منظر خیبر پختونخوا میں 11 اکتوبر کو آئین کے آرٹیکل 234 کے تحت نافذ کیے جانے والے گورنر راج کے بعد مزید شدت اختیار کر گیا ہے جس پر مولانا فضل الرحمان نے شدید تحفظات کا اظہار کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Karachi Consumer Files Rs3.5 Million Lawsuit Over Defective Fridge
stories.summary:
A citizen in Karachi named Yasir Ashfaq has lodged a formal damages suit at the Consumer Court against an electronics dealer and a private company. Represented by his lawyer Usman Farooq, the plaintiff initiated the legal action citing fraud, financial loss, and severe mental distress.

According to the legal counsel, the consumer purchased a refrigerator priced at Rs102,000 from a shop located at Saddar's Hashoo Centre. Although the purchase receipt included a warranty mention, the merchant reportedly failed to provide a formal warranty document.

When the buyer subsequently contacted the manufacturing company regarding the guarantee, the firm refused to acknowledge the retail outlet as an authorized dealer. Consequently, the plaintiff is demanding Rs3.5 million in compensation for the malfunctioning appliance and alleged misrepresentation.

The lawyer argued before the court that selling faulty merchandise and neglecting warranty obligations represent unlawful and misleading consumer practices. Following the initial arguments, the Consumer Court issued notices requiring both the private company and the dealer to submit formal replies at the upcoming hearing.

stories.title: Federal Minister Salik Hussain to Respond to Maryam Nawaz Legal Notice
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Overseas Pakistanis and Human Resource Development Chaudhry Salik Hussain announced that he will soon submit a court response to a legal notice sent by Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz. The legal dispute arose after Salik Hussain criticized the Punjab government during an exclusive television interview with ARY News, where he alleged that corruption was widespread in the province and claimed that cupboards would be full of corruption files rather than just folders.

Maryam Nawaz sought Rs5 billion in damages through her lawyer, asserting that the minister's allegations were baseless, unverified, and defamatory. She stated that Salik Hussain failed to provide any supporting evidence, documents, investigations, or formal complaints during his broadcast. Legal notices were additionally issued to ARY News and reporter Naeem Ashraf Butt for airing the interview.

The Punjab Chief Minister defended her administration and questioned whether the minister's remarks stemmed from dissatisfaction over the recent administrative transfer of the Deputy Commissioner of Gujrat. She also noted that Salik Hussain had previously praised the government of former chief minister Pervaiz Elahi, whom he described as the best chief minister during his lifetime.

Beyond the corruption remarks, Salik Hussain had previously voiced concerns regarding administrative inefficiencies, development fund distributions, and governance issues in Punjab. He alleged that political preferences influenced budget allocations, leaving certain districts deprived while prioritizing areas represented by government-backed candidates. He also questioned the use of official aircraft and argued that ministers require empowered authority rather than restricted capabilities to effectively deliver results.

Separately, the World Wide Fund for Nature reported a sperm whale sighting measuring 45 feet in length located 40 nautical miles southwest of Karachi, marking the first documented sighting of a sperm whale in those waters.

stories.title: Malaysian Palm Oil Slips on Rival Oils, Facing Steep Weekly Drop
stories.summary:
Malaysian palm oil futures experienced a downward movement on Friday, positioning the market for its most significant weekly decline since December 2024. The downward pressure was primarily driven by weaker rival edible oils, though firmer crude oil prices helped cushion the impact and limited total losses during early trading sessions.

The benchmark palm oil contract scheduled for January delivery on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange recorded a decrease of 14 ringgit, translating to a 0.32 percent drop, which brought its trading value to 4,363 ringgit or approximately $1,078.88 per metric ton.

Throughout the week, the contract accumulated a total decrease of 6.69 percent. This consistent downward trajectory puts the market on course to register its second consecutive week of losses.

Market participants continue to monitor price movements closely as the broader edible oils sector responds to shifting regional trends and external commodity influences. The ongoing weakness in competing vegetable oils outweighed the supportive influence coming from stronger crude oil markets on Friday.

stories.title: Soybeans and Corn Rise on Oil Prices but Face Weekly Losses
stories.summary:
Soybean and corn futures experienced a modest increase on Friday, supported by rising crude oil prices which often influence agricultural goods utilized in biofuel production. Despite the daily gains, both markets remained on track for weekly losses due to ample global supplies and anticipated crop reports from the United States Department of Agriculture.

The most-active soybean contract on the Chicago Board of Trade rose by 0.3 percent to reach $11.92-1/4 a bushel, while corn increased by 0.1 percent to $4.40-1/2 a bushel. Conversely, wheat fell 0.3 percent to $5.97-1/2 a bushel. Soybeans recorded a weekly decline of over three percent, marking their largest weekly drop since late July, while corn headed toward its sixth straight weekly loss.

Grains and oilseeds drew strength from a strong rally in crude oil futures. Brent crude settled over $3 higher per barrel following tanker attacks that heightened supply concerns and prompted market reassessments regarding the U.S.-Israeli conflict with Iran. Traders are also awaiting the U.S. Department of Agriculture's monthly report next week, where analysts expect corn production estimates to be adjusted to 15.962 billion bushels and soybean production to reach a record 4.597 billion bushels.

Meanwhile, wheat prices faced pressure from the potential resumption of Black Sea grain exports. Although the Russia-Ukraine war previously disrupted shipping lanes, alternative export pathways through Baltic ports and Romanian routes have prevented severe shortages. Furthermore, confirmation that Russia and Ukraine will participate in tripartite peace talks with the U.S. in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11 has heightened prospects for renewed access to traditional Black Sea shipping routes.

stories.title: Pakistan Navigates Complex Geopolitical Realities Amid Global Shifts
stories.summary:
The global geopolitical landscape increasingly mirrors the game of Tetris, where states face shrinking time and space, diminishing choices, and rising vulnerabilities as major powers shift. Russia remains tied down in Ukraine, Europe grapples with security, energy and economic pressures, and an expanding Middle Eastern conflict involving Iran, Israel, and the United States threatens global supply chains and economic growth.

Amid these interconnected crises, China has maintained strategic restraint in the Middle East despite its massive economic stakes. Observers analyzing the emerging order offer different perspectives, including offensive realism predicting a US-China bipolar dominance, views seeing Donald Trump's administration as a temporary disruption to traditional alliances, and theories of an untidy, overlapping multipolar system where nations rely on different powers for infrastructure, finance, security, and energy.

For Pakistan, this shifting global order presents critical choices regarding alliances, regional integration, and economic priorities. Analysts suggest that Islamabad should avoid strategic overextension and focus primarily on national strength through economic growth, political stability, and development rather than chasing a leading global role.

If the world moves toward sharper US-China bipolarity, Pakistan must avoid becoming a frontline state while maintaining China as its principal strategic anchor alongside working relations with Washington. In a multipolar scenario, Islamabad should leverage increased diplomatic space through broad engagement with global powers and regional states, provided its national economy is strong enough to support such maneuverability.

stories.title: PTI Urges Chief Justice to Enforce Treatment Orders for Jailed Imran Khan
stories.summary:
The core committee of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) has expressed deep alarm over the health of imprisoned party founder Imran Khan following reports that his blood pressure recently surged to 192. Meeting in Islamabad for a late-night session, committee members cited a severe lack of adequate medical facilities and persistent obstacles preventing his family and personal physicians from visiting him.

The party labeled Khan's deteriorating health an urgent humanitarian and medical emergency rather than a routine political dispute. The committee demanded that the government grant Imran's personal physicians immediate, unhindered access, conduct necessary diagnostic tests without delay, and transfer him to Shifa International Hospital for comprehensive medical evaluation and treatment. Additionally, the party raised concerns over jailed PTI Vice Chairperson Shah Mahmood Qureshi, who suffered a fall in prison, demanding his immediate hospital transfer.

PTI leaders appealed to the Pakistani public and overseas nationals to raise urgent awareness regarding Khan's condition at both national and international levels. They also called upon the chief justice of Pakistan to ensure the effective implementation of existing court orders concerning the former prime minister's medical treatment, emphasizing that administrative bodies have a constitutional responsibility to comply.

Imran Khan has been incarcerated since August 2023, during which time his health has seen multiple complications, including an eye ailment identified in late January. Although the Supreme Court previously ordered his transfer to Shifa International Hospital following recommendations from a medical board at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS), government authorities diverted him to PIMS before returning him to prison. Information Minister Attaullah Tarar blamed the diversion on security situations created by PTI workers, while the party accused the government of deliberately flouting judicial directives.

stories.title: Oil Prices Head for Weekly Drop Amid Middle East Supply Concerns
stories.summary:
Global oil prices are on track for a steep weekly decline driven by expectations of potential de-escalation in the Middle East conflict following election setbacks for US President Donald Trump's party. However, ongoing security incidents in the Gulf continue to provide a floor for the market.

In Friday trading, Brent crude futures for January rose $1.29, or 1.31%, to reach $99.58 a barrel, briefly touching the $100 mark earlier in the session. US West Texas Intermediate futures increased by 86 cents, or 0.95%, to $91.38 a barrel. Despite the daily rebound, Brent is heading for a weekly drop of 12%, while WTI is set to fall 12.1% after significant drops earlier in the week.

Prices plunged by 8% on Wednesday alone, hitting two-month lows after Democrats swept the US midterm elections, raising hopes for a shift in US-Israeli policy regarding Iran. Nevertheless, a renewed wave of tanker attacks in the Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday and Thursday quickly reversed some of those losses, keeping supply fears alive.

According to analysts, the recent price recovery is a technical bounceback as the market recognizes that Middle Eastern supply risks remain unresolved. With Iran reporting additional tanker attacks and British maritime security data indicating near-record activity against oil-carrying vessels, oil prices remain highly vulnerable to escalation headlines until safer transit routes are established.

stories.title: Japan's Nikkei Plunges Over Five Percent Amid Global Technology Selloff
stories.summary:
Japan's benchmark Nikkei share average dropped sharply by over 5% on Friday, marking its worst single-day performance in eight months. The dramatic selloff was driven by heavy losses among heavyweight technology stocks amid growing anxiety over potential regulatory crackdowns and a slowdown in artificial intelligence spending following the Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections.

The downturn in Tokyo mirrored severe overnight losses on Wall Street, where both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite suffered their steepest daily declines since April 2025. The broad-based decline affected nearly the entire Japanese market, with 221 out of 225 components on the Nikkei index falling and all 33 industry sectors on the broader Topix index sliding.

Prominent AI-linked stocks and market darlings suffered the heaviest blows, with startup investor SoftBank Group plunging 9.3% and chip-testing equipment manufacturer Advantest dropping 4.6%. Market strategists noted that future market volatility is likely as investors weigh rising infrastructure costs, potential construction delays in AI data centers, and concerns over long-term corporate profitability.

Volatility gauges on the Nikkei rose to their highest levels since March 31. With consistent losses throughout the week, the benchmark index is heading for a weekly decline of 8.6%, which would mark its worst weekly performance since March of the previous year.

stories.title: خیبر پختون خوا پولیس کا وزیرِ اعظم کو مخصوص اضلاع کیلئے فنڈز کا ڈرافٹ ارسال
stories.summary:
خیبر پختون خوا پولیس کی جانب سے وفاقی حکومت کو صوبے کی سکیورٹی اور ترقیاتی ضروریات سے آگاہ کرنے کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔ اسی سلسلے میں خیبر پختون خوا پولیس نے وزیرِ اعظم شہباز شریف کو ایک اہم ڈرافٹ ارسال کیا ہے۔

یہ ڈرافٹ خیبر پختون خوا کے مخصوص اضلاع کے لیے درکار فنڈز کے حصول کے لیے بھیجا گیا ہے۔ اس ڈرافٹ میں صوبے کے مخصوص اضلاع کی مالی ضروریات اور دیگر متعلقہ امور کی تفصیلات شامل کی گئی ہیں۔

اس اقدام کا مقصد ان مخصوص اضلاع میں پولیس اور انتظامی ڈھانچے کو بہتر بنانا اور درکار وسائل کی فراہمی کو یقینی بنانا ہے۔ فنڈز سے متعلق یہ ڈرافٹ وفاقی سطح پر غور کے لیے پیش کیا گیا ہے۔

مذکورہ ڈرافٹ کے حوالے سے مزید تفصیلات سامنے نہیں آئیں، تاہم اس کا بنیادی مقصد صوبے کے ان مخصوص اضلاع میں سکیورٹی اور انتظامی امور کے لیے مالی معاونت حاصل کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: آسٹریلیا جانے والے مسافر کی انڈونیشیا میں بھارتی شہری بن کر پناہ پر ایف آئی اے کی تفتیش
stories.summary:
کراچی میں وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے (ایف آئی اے) کے امیگریشن حکام نے ایک ایسے مسافر کے خلاف باضابطہ طور پر تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے جو آسٹریلیا کا سفر کر رہا تھا۔ ذرائع کے مطابق یہ مسافر اس سے قبل انڈونیشیا میں مبینہ طور پر خود کو بھارتی شہری ظاہر کر کے سیاسی یا دیگر پناہ حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کرتا رہا ہے۔

ایف آئی اے کے ترجمان کے مطابق یہ امر انتہائی تشویشناک ہے کہ پاکستانی شہری نے بیرون ملک جاکر اپنی شناخت کیوں چھپائی اور بھارتی شہری بن کر پناہ کی درخواست دی۔ اس نوعیت کے جعلی ہتھکنڈے بین الاقوامی سفر اور ملکی ساکھ کے لیے سنگین مسائل کا باعث بنتے ہیں، جس کی وجہ سے تحقیقات کا دائرہ وسیع کیا گیا ہے۔

حکام اس مسافر کے سفری دستاویزات، پاسپورٹ اور دیگر ریکارڈ کی چھان بین کر رہے ہیں تاکہ یہ معلوم کیا جا سکے کہ اس نے کب اور کن حالات میں انڈونیشیا میں یہ جعلسازی کی تھی۔ تفتیش مکمل ہونے کے بعد اس مسافر کے خلاف قانونی کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔

stories.title: Pakistan Strongly Condemns Houthi Missile Strikes Targeting Saudi Arabia
stories.summary:
Pakistan formally issued a strong condemnation on Friday against recent Houthi ballistic missile attacks directed at Saudi Arabia, focusing specifically on the Makkah and Madinah regions. During a weekly press briefing in Islamabad, Foreign Office spokesperson Tahir Andrabi denounced the strikes as a direct violation of Saudi sovereignty, a severe disregard for civilian safety, and an assault on the sanctity of Islam's holiest sites. Alongside the condemnation, Pakistan reaffirmed its steadfast solidarity with Riyadh and underscored its ongoing commitment to the Makkah Alliance for Defence.

This diplomatic stance coincides with a broader series of regional and international engagements aimed at mitigating Middle Eastern tensions. On October 23, foreign ministers from Pakistan, Turkiye, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia convened in Istanbul for the R4 ministerial meeting. During this summit, the officials addressed critical geopolitical flashpoints, including the conflicts involving the United States, Israel, and Iran, the situation in Palestine, Yemen, and security concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea. The ministers advocated for dialogue, an immediate cessation of violence, unhindered humanitarian access to Gaza, and the realization of a two-state solution.

Later that same day, the R4 foreign ministers extended their consultations in Istanbul to include counterparts from France, Germany, Italy, and the United Kingdom. Discussions with these European officials centered on collective approaches to maritime security, regional de-escalation, and international diplomatic cooperation. In related bilateral developments, Makkah Alliance Secretary General Lieutenant General Noman Mahmood met with Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar on October 28 to emphasize the alliance's critical role in securing lasting regional peace.

Islamabad has simultaneously advanced diplomatic ties with various global partners. Singapore's Foreign Minister Dr. Vivian Balakrishnan visited Pakistan on October 30 to mark the 60th anniversary of diplomatic relations, leading to signed memorandums concerning disaster management and expanded economic cooperation. Furthermore, Chinese Communist Party official Liu Haixing visited Islamabad on November 1, where he and Foreign Minister Dar co-chaired governance seminars, reaffirming the enduring strategic partnership and economic corridor cooperation between Pakistan and China.

stories.title: Asian Markets Slide as US Tech Rout Sparks AI Bubble Fears
stories.summary:
China and Hong Kong stocks experienced a downturn as a technology selloff on the Nasdaq rippled across Asia. The widespread market correction fueled investor concerns that the artificial intelligence boom was losing momentum, following an overnight drop on Wall Street driven by apprehensions over potential political shifts in the United States.

In mainland China, the blue-chip CSI300 Index fell 1.5% by the midday break, while tech-heavy sectors such as the Star 50 and AI Index plunged up to 5% before recovering some ground. In Hong Kong, the benchmark Hang Seng Index dropped 1%, and the Hang Seng Artificial Intelligence Index fell 4%. Markets in South Korea and Japan also suffered sharp losses during early trading hours, reflecting broader regional anxiety.

Analysts noted that the steep decline in US technology stocks severely damaged the confidence supporting the global AI rally. Chinese hardware and software firms with close ties to the American market faced heavy selling pressure, with companies like Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink Technology, and Zhipu recording substantial drops. Market observers pointed out that the heavy weighting of technology stocks in China leaves local sentiment vulnerable to valuation concerns originating in the United States.

Despite the morning panic, bargain hunting helped cushion mainland markets, keeping the CSI300 on course for weekly gains supported by Beijing's ongoing economic stabilization measures. Strategists emphasized that while broader risk aversion impacts the entire supply chain, domestic players focused on technological self-reliance are primarily driven by local growth factors rather than overseas sentiment alone.

stories.title: Iran Submits Nuclear Proposal to United States via Qatari Mediators
stories.summary:
Iran has transmitted a nuclear proposal to the United States through Qatar, according to a senior Iranian official who spoke on condition of anonymity. The official stated that Washington is currently reviewing the document, though further specifics regarding the proposal's contents were withheld. The diplomatic maneuver occurs amid heightened international efforts to prevent the re-escalation of conflict following recent political shifts in the United States.

Earlier on Thursday, Iran's top security official, Mohsen Rezaei, speaking during a visit to Russia, outlined strict prerequisites for any diplomatic engagement or reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Rezaei reiterated that Tehran demands the execution of seven specific conditions by the United States before talks can proceed. These core demands include the lifting of economic sanctions, the release of frozen Iranian assets, and the payment of war reparations.

These diplomatic developments follow a period of open military escalation that began on February 28, when the United States and Israel launched attacks against Iran. Tehran responded with retaliatory strikes targeting Israel as well as Gulf states hosting American military installations. The broader conflict also drew in Iran-backed groups, including Hezbollah in Lebanon and the Houthis in Yemen, who have launched attacks on regional infrastructure.

Meanwhile, global energy markets reacted to shifting political landscapes and potential de-escalation prospects. While crude prices faced downward pressure over weekly expectations of easing tensions, ongoing security anxieties in the Middle East continued to provide fundamental support for oil futures.

stories.title: Australia Appoints Mike Hussey as Consultant Coach to Fix Batting
stories.summary:
Cricket Australia announced the appointment of Mike Hussey as a long-term consultant coach on Friday. The move is designed to address recurring batting vulnerabilities within the national team ahead of a demanding international schedule that features next year's Ashes series in England, the 50-over World Cup, and preparation cycles for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and the subsequent T20 World Cup.

The coaching addition comes in the wake of mounting scrutiny over Australia's red-ball form. Pat Cummins' squad recently suffered a 2-1 test series defeat against South Africa, marked by a dramatic collapse on the final day of the third test. That setback followed an unprecedented nine-wicket loss to Bangladesh in Darwin in August, highlighting urgent concerns within the batting lineup.

Hussey, a 51-year-old former player who represented Australia across 302 matches, expressed enthusiasm about taking on a more formal role to assist the coaching staff and players. Affectionately known as "Mr. Cricket," Hussey brings extensive coaching experience, having previously worked with England during their 2022 T20 World Cup victory alongside various franchise commitments in the Indian Premier League and The Hundred.

Australia head coach Andrew McDonald praised Hussey's multi-format expertise and interpersonal qualities, noting that his skill set complements the existing team structure. Hussey is scheduled to officially commence his duties during Australia's upcoming T20 series against England, which gets underway on November 21.

stories.title: UN Security Council Adopts Pakistan-Initiated Statement Promoting Wartime Diplomacy
stories.summary:
The United Nations Security Council adopted a presidential statement spearheaded by Pakistan, emphasizing the critical need for continued diplomatic engagement after the outbreak of armed conflicts. Titled "The Role of Diplomacy during Active Hostilities," the document calls on member states to prioritize sustained mediation, direct or indirect communication, and structured efforts to secure ceasefires and prevent regional escalation.

Adopted under the November presidency of Latvia’s Ambassador Sanita Pavļuta-Deslandes, the initiative builds upon Resolution 2788, which was unanimously passed during Pakistan's council presidency in July 2025.
